in_marathi.name: Gurleen
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gurleen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit ‘Gur’ meaning 'guru' and ‘Leen’ meaning ‘light’. This name is given to a child born under the guidance and blessings of a revered guru or teacher.
